comment: Test pool machines (tools/remote/pool.mjs, docs/worktrees.md 'Test pool'). Override per machine with the "pool" key of the gitignored lf.local.json. A machine with "lanes" runs tests and sessions apart: the session lane is the server-2001 lock on UDP 2001 (sessions, host, serve; clients join it), each test lane is its own server-test-<k> lock with a server on 127.0.0.1:2001+k (-addr). Without "lanes" a machine keeps one shared lane of "slots" servers on 2001. sessionIdleMin: a session idle this long while a job waits is closed. promoteMin: a queued job moves up one priority level per this many minutes. minFreeMb: a second concurrent server waits while free RAM is under this. bootBudgetS: a server not ready by then is killed (exit 124). A machine's budgetMultiplier scales the seeded run budgets and the boot budget (the laptop is about 2x slower). sessionHoldMin: a session started after the cap existed that is older than this while another session request queues is warned, then closed sessionGraceMin later (session up --hold <min> raises its own, to sessionHoldMaxMin); with nobody queued there is no cap.
